title: Junior Engineer (Mechanical)
organization: Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB)
application_fee: Rs. 600 for General; Rs. 500 for SC, ST-1, ST-2, EWS, and PwBD
age_limit: 40 years for OM; 43 years for reserved categories; 42 years for PwBD (as of 01.01.2026)
summary: The JKSSB invites online applications for 127 Junior Engineer (Mechanical) posts in the Public Works (R&B) Department. Selection will be based on an objective-type written examination with negative marking.
eligibility_bullets: Must be a Domicile of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir.
Must possess the prescribed educational qualification by the cut-off date.
Age limit varies by category (40-43 years) as of 01.01.2026.
Valid category certificates must be uploaded at the time of application.
how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official JKSSB website at www.jkssb.nic.in.
Register and fill out the online application form carefully.
Upload required documents and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee through online modes (Net Banking, Credit/Debit cards).
Review and submit the application before the deadline.
